'''Tann Gella''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Tann and her twin sister, [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann]], were trained as [[Yobana/Legends|yobanas]] and sold to [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] from [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Biography==
Tann Gella was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], who, along with her twin-sister [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann]], was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="atg" /> Ann and Tann were trained as [[Yobana/Legends|yobanas]], a [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] word that loosely translated to masseuse. Due to their training,<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] purchased the [[Currency/Legends|expensively priced]] pair<ref name="ExpandedVD" /> from<ref name="atg" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{DB|character|jabbathehutt|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]<ref name="atg" /> to be enslaved masseuses. The Dug did this partly to put him into the best form for Podraces<ref name="ExpandedVD" /> &mdash;as the Twi'lek's gave ritual prerace massages to him&mdash;<ref name=":0">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Sebulba (Boonta Eve Challenge)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjsebulba.asp}}</ref> though mostly did it to irritate other Podracers and get them jealous. His tactic was resoundingly effective.<ref name="ExpandedVD" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Tann and her Twin gave a massage to Sebulba in his chair before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Tann, a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] Twi'lek<ref name="ExpandedVD" /> female, had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="atg" />

==Skills and abilities==
Tann her sister were trained as yobanas.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters" />

==Equipment==
Both Tann and her sister wore form-fitting [[Tromin unigarment]]s, slave collars, and white [[Clothing/Legends|headdresses]] with silver pieces.<ref name="ExpandedVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tann and her sister first appeared in the [[1999]] film {{Film|I}}.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace" /> In the film, Tann Gella was portrayed by actress [[Nishan Hindes]].<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-a-family-affair|text=''Star Wars'', A Family Affair|nolive=1}}</ref> Tann and her sister appear in a question in the [[StarWars.com]] game ''[[Garbage Masher]]'', in which the objective is to save [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from being crushed in a [[Garbage compactor/Legends|garbage compactor]].<ref name="Garbage Masher">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/garbage_masher|text=Garbage Masher|int=Garbage Masher}}</ref>
